reviews.text: The doctor is trustworthy. The staff's service is also excellent.

I was given a different medication each time than the one I had requested.
The receptionist apologized for not keeping track of my treatment, but it's terrible considering it's a matter of life and death.
The doctor offered no apology whatsoever.

The doctor who was in charge last time was also changed without my consent, which makes me extremely distrustful.
I was even made to book an appointment for a day when that doctor was working.

You shouldn't choose a hospital just because it's close.
I will never go there again.
Several of the receptionists are unfriendly and cold.
Those who go should be careful.
Despite it being within business hours, they closed the shutters and recommended I go to an emergency hospital at night, saying, "The doctor will be gone soon."
The doctor saved my dog just in time. I see some negative reviews but every time I’ve been they’ve been great and super helpful.

They basically do nothing.

My child was killed here too.

The doctor is very caring and attentive.

The staff are also kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my child in their care. Thank you so much!

Refused care to an animal because do not want to work with customers who do not speak Japanese. I recommend them to place pet care at the center of their priority instead. Google translator works very well, and translation should not be a barrier for doing what is right.
There were what appeared to be other children's organs lying around, which was unsanitary and unpleasant.
